Goal: Book a shift for Ifeoma Garroway, mobile 07700 900123, with 3 years at sea.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p32.html
STEP 2: Enter "Ifeoma Garroway" in the name field
STEP 3: Enter "07700 900123" in the mobile number field
STEP 4: Enter "3" in the years at sea field
